{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:27.099
    | text      = You decide to go to...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:29.099
    | text      = Yeah, my wife and I went to Costa Rica to essentially go on adventures.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:35.099
    | text      = Yeah, and I went to my hometown to relive traumatic memories in past places.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:42.099
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:43.099
    | text      = So I went back to Columbia, Missouri.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:45.099
    | text      = It was a very nice time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:47.099
    | text      = All in all, great to see my boy Burger again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:50.099
    | text      = Shout out to Swear Engine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:53.099
    | text      = Probably the best thing was I got to go back to Forum 8, the theater I worked at for many years.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:00.099
    | text      = And I thought that I would get really emotional within the projection booth if they'd let me up there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:06.099
    | text      = And it was a negotiation to get up there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:09.099
    | text      = I will say that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:10.099
    | text      = I went and I asked the person at the concession stand to talk to the manager.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:14.099
    | text      = And the manager comes over and I think he thinks I was up to espionage.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:20.099
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:21.099
    | text      = He's like, leave your name and number.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:24.099
    | text      = I'll talk to my manager.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:25.099
    | text      = You dirty commie.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:26.099
    | text      = So I went to go see a movie and then came out and they let me upstairs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:31.099
    | text      = He had cleared me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:32.099
    | text      = That's great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:33.099
    | text      = Checked with McCarthy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:34.099
    | text      = Good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:35.099
    | text      = I got the all good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:36.099
    | text      = Alright, alright.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:37.099
    | text      = But I went upstairs and there's no film anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:40.099
    | text      = There's just digital projectors.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:42.099
    | text      = And so that wasn't all that overwhelming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:45.099
    | text      = But then we came down the stairs from the projection booth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:49.099
    | text      = And right near the stairs is the back exit that goes out to the dumpster.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:54.099
    | text      = And I immediately was like, I gotta go out to the dumpster.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:57.099
    | text      = I gotta go out there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:58.099
    | text      = That's where we used to get high.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:59.099
    | text      = Of course.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:00.099
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:01.099
    | text      = Smoke cigarettes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:02.099
    | text      = Scene of the crime.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:03.099
    | text      = I started smoking cigarettes just to go out there on breaks with the managers and be cool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:09.099
    | text      = And so we go out there and the manager is telling me, hey, we have this state of the art dumpster.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:16.099
    | text      = My man, that was there when it was exactly the same.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:20.099
    | text      = Right, right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:21.099
    | text      = But there is a pole, a little pole that's coming out of the ground.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:25.099
    | text      = It's not connected to anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:27.099
    | text      = It might have been at some point.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:29.099
    | text      = But back when I used to work there, we would smoke cigarettes and put them in the pole.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:34.099
    | text      = Because the pole had an open top.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:36.099
    | text      = Fools.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:37.099
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:38.099
    | text      = We filled it up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:39.099
    | text      = And instead of cleaning it out, we just taped over it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:42.099
    | text      = That makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:43.099
    | text      = And it was always this thing that was there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:45.099
    | text      = There's like this taped over pole and it's full of our cigarette butts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:49.099
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:50.099
    | text      = And out by the dumpster, it was still there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:52.099
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:53.099
    | text      = And I was like, hey man, do you know why that's taped over?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:55.099
    | text      = The tape was still on top of it too?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:57.099
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:58.099
    | text      = Get the fuck out of here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:59.099
    | text      = Yeah, so I told him and I was like, man, this is great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:01.099
    | text      = This is fun to be like connected to a piece of lore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:04.099
    | text      = This physical thing is still here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:06.099
    | text      = And he was like, you gotta clean that up, buddy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:08.099
    | text      = No, he was charmed by it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:09.099
    | text      = Oh, okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:10.099
    | text      = He seemed like he dug it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:11.099
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:12.099
    | text      = So it was kind of a cool be able to like, hey, here's a little secret about that pole.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:16.100
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:17.100
    | text      = We live in the present now, but I used to also be in the past.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:20.100
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:21.100
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:22.100
    | text      = And that pole was there in both.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:23.100
    | text      = It's a constant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:24.100
    | text      = Yes, exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:25.100
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:26.100
    | text      = So the pole that I used to put cigarette butts in was probably a high point of the trip.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:30.100
    | text      = That's actually pretty interesting and fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:32.100
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:33.100
    | text      = So what about you?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:34.100
    | text      = What's your bright spot?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:35.100
    | text      = My bright spot is obviously the trip.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:37.100
    | text      = My wife and I went on our, we didn't have a honeymoon and she's turning 40 this year.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:41.100
    | text      = So we did it up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:42.100
    | text      = I did it all by myself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:45.100
    | text      = I did the whole planet and all that stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:47.100
    | text      = And you know, you know, yeah, well, I mean, she's the responsible one, but like, you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:54.100
    | text      = I was thinking about it and I was thinking about like competition, playing sports, you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:00.100
    | text      = know, sometimes you can do everything right and it still just goes wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:04.100
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:05.100
    | text      = Just, it's just how it works.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:06.100

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:09.100
    | text      = And sometimes you do a good job and things work out well and then sometimes you just
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = have those days where you're just fucking, everything works.

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:27.100

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:21.740
    | text      = This has to do with Hortman's recent vote for SSFH1, a bill that would strip undocumented
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = people over the age of 18 from being eligible for participation in Minnesota Care.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:32.400
    | text      = To give a little background context on this, Minnesota's legislature had been in the process
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:36.519
    | text      = of trying to pass a two-year budget, and in May, they announced that they'd reached an
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:40.299
    | text      = agreement.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:41.559
    | text      = Part of that agreement was the cutting of Minnesota Care access for the undocumented
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:45.380
    | text      = immigrants, but this budget agreement doesn't just become law because the party leaders,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:50.859
    | text      = they all agreed on it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:52.500
    | text      = In Minnesota, the members of the state house and senate don't vote on the full budget as
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:56.700
    | text      = a yes or no bill, like one thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:59.779
    | text      = They vote on each piece individually.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:02.059
    | text      = Thus, even though they had this agreement for the budget, it could still lead to fights
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:06.819
    | text      = down the road or potential compromises needing to be made between lawmakers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:12.500
    | text      = Democrats in the house were trying very hard to get the Republicans to budge on the Minnesota
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:16.659
    | text      = Care issue, but it was very clear that this was a hard line for the GOP.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:20.579
    | text      = The GOP also made it fairly clear that they were willing to shut down the government and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:25.139
    | text      = not vote to pass other areas of the budget if they didn't get their way on this part,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:29.380

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:32.900
    | text      = Hortman was the only member of the DFL to vote for the bill, but it would have passed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = I can't see for sure, but I really suspect that she voted the way that she did as a sign
